migrations.risk: Additive private file claims and exact-byte cleanup custody. No Project or shared-conversation ACL. Uploads require separate opt-in and supported schema/storage.

proofs.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM pragma_table_info('personal_chat_attachments') WHERE name IN ('id','owner_id','client_request_id','request_hash','filename','mime_type','size_bytes','backend','storage_key','state','writer_settled','custody_until','expires_at','created_at') AND "notnull"=1
SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='index' AND name IN ('idx_personal_chat_attachment_request','idx_personal_chat_attachment_owner','idx_personal_chat_attachment_message')
SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' AND name='personal_chat_attachments' AND sql LIKE '%personal_chat_attachment_state%'
SELECT integrity_check AS value FROM pragma_integrity_check
SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM pragma_foreign_key_check

postconditions: Owner/request index is unique; owner/message index preserves file order.
States, backends, bounded sizes and request hashes are constrained.
Cleanup custody has no cascading user/Project deletion.
migrations.rollbackPlan: Disable SIGNAL_PERSONAL_CHAT_ATTACHMENTS_ENABLED. Preserve accepted private files and cleanup custody; do not drop rows or bytes without a separate lifecycle decision. Production apply requires the owning backup and release procedure.
